package wasm

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type containedEvent struct {
	Kind   uint32 `json:"kind"`
	Before uint32 `json:"before"`
	Length uint32 `json:"length"`
}

type containedCase struct {
	Export string           `json:"export"`
	Trap   string           `json:"trap"`
	Memory []byte           `json:"memory"`
	Events []containedEvent `json:"events"`
	Base   uint32           `json:"base"`
	Flag   uint32           `json:"flag"`
	Result uint32           `json:"result"`
	Prefix uint32           `json:"prefix"`
}

type containedHost struct {
	module   *Module
	callback func()
	events   []containedEvent
}

func (host *containedHost) Init(value any) { host.module = value.(*Module) }

func (host *containedHost) Xtouch() {
	memory := *host.module.Xmemory().Slice()
	host.events = append(host.events, containedEvent{1, binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(memory), uint32(len(memory))})
	if host.callback != nil {
		host.callback()
		return
	}
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(memory, 0x11223345)
}

func (host *containedHost) Ximpure(value int32) int32 {
	memory := *host.module.Xmemory().Slice()
	host.events = append(host.events, containedEvent{2, binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(memory), uint32(len(memory))})
	if host.callback != nil {
		host.callback()
	}
	return value
}

func containedBytes(length int) []byte {
	data := make([]byte, length)
	for index := range data {
		data[index] = byte(index*7 + 3)
	}
	return data
}

func callContained(module *Module, name string, base, flag int32) (result uint32, trap string) {
	defer func() {
		if value := recover(); value != nil {
			if fault, ok := value.(runtime.Error); ok && strings.Contains(fault.Error(), "out of range") {
				trap = "memory"
			} else {
				trap = fmt.Sprintf("%T: %v", value, value)
			}
		}
	}()
	var answer int32
	switch name {
	case "covered":
		answer = module.Xcovered(base)
	case "triple":
		answer = module.Xtriple(base)
	case "rising":
		answer = module.Xrising(base)
	case "rebind":
		answer = module.Xrebind(base)
	case "wrapped":
		answer = module.Xwrapped(base)
	case "imported":
		answer = module.Ximported(base)
	case "stored":
		answer = module.Xstored(base)
	case "conditional":
		answer = module.Xconditional(base, flag)
	case "grown":
		answer = module.Xgrown(base)
	case "two_bases":
		answer = module.Xtwo_bases(base, flag)
	case "shadow":
		answer = module.XshadowFunc(base)
	case "label":
		answer = module.Xlabel(base, flag)
	case "global":
		answer = module.XglobalBase()
	default:
		panic("unknown contained export " + name)
	}
	return uint32(answer), ""
}

func TestContainedLoadOracle(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile("cases.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []containedCase
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(cases) < 400 {
		t.Fatal("contained-load missing bounded independent cases", len(cases))
	}
	for _, entry := range cases {
		host := new(containedHost)
		module := New(host)
		copy(*module.Xmemory().Slice(), containedBytes(65536))
		answer, trap := callContained(module, entry.Export, int32(entry.Base), int32(entry.Flag))
		memory := *module.Xmemory().Slice()
		if answer != entry.Result || trap != entry.Trap || uint32(module.Xprefix()) != entry.Prefix || !bytes.Equal(memory, entry.Memory) {
			t.Fatalf("contained-load oracle mismatch: %s base=%x flag=%d result=%x/%x trap=%q/%q prefix=%d/%d memory=%v lengths=%d/%d", entry.Export, entry.Base, entry.Flag, answer, entry.Result, trap, entry.Trap, module.Xprefix(), entry.Prefix, bytes.Equal(memory, entry.Memory), len(memory), len(entry.Memory))
		}
		if len(host.events) != len(entry.Events) {
			t.Fatal("contained-load event count mismatch", host.events, entry.Events)
		}
		for index, event := range entry.Events {
			if host.events[index] != event {
				t.Fatal("contained-load event order mismatch", host.events, entry.Events)
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestContainedLoadLogicalLength(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"covered", "triple", "rising"} {
		for length := 0; length <= 20; length++ {
			for base := 0; base <= 3; base++ {
				module := New(new(containedHost))
				backing := containedBytes(64)
				*module.Xmemory().Slice() = backing[:length]
				answer, trap := callContained(module, name, int32(base), 0)
				wantTrap := base+12 > length
				if (trap == "memory") != wantTrap || trap != "" && trap != "memory" {
					t.Fatalf("contained-load logical length mismatch: %s len=%d cap=%d base=%d trap=%q expected=%v", name, length, cap(backing), base, trap, wantTrap)
				}
				if !wantTrap {
					low := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(backing[base:])
					middle := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(backing[base+4:])
					high := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(backing[base+8:])
					want := high*3 + low*5
					if name == "triple" {
						want = middle*3 + high*5 + low*7
					}
					if name == "rising" {
						want = low*3 + middle*5 + high*7
					}
					if answer != want {
						t.Fatal("contained-load weighted result mismatch", name, answer, want)
					}
				}
				if !bytes.Equal(backing, containedBytes(64)) || module.Xprefix() != 1 {
					t.Fatal("contained-load trap prefix mismatch")
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestContainedLoadHeaderBarrier(t *testing.T) {
	for _, replace := range []bool{false, true} {
		host := new(containedHost)
		module := New(host)
		old := containedBytes(64)
		*module.Xmemory().Slice() = old
		host.callback = func() {
			backing := old
			if replace {
				backing = containedBytes(64)
			}
			*module.Xmemory().Slice() = backing[:3]
		}
		if _, trap := callContained(module, "imported", 0, 0); trap != "memory" || len(host.events) != 1 || module.Xprefix() != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("contained-load import barrier mismatch: replace=%v trap=%q events=%v", replace, trap, host.events)
		}
		if host.events[0] != (containedEvent{1, binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(old), 64}) || !bytes.Equal(old, containedBytes(64)) {
			t.Fatal("contained-load import prefix mismatch")
		}
		if (&old[0] != &(*module.Xmemory().Slice())[0]) != replace {
			t.Fatal("contained-load replacement path mismatch")
		}
	}
	host := new(containedHost)
	module := New(host)
	old := containedBytes(64)
	*module.Xmemory().Slice() = old
	host.callback = func() {
		replacement := containedBytes(64)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(replacement, 12345)
		*module.Xmemory().Slice() = replacement
	}
	answer, trap := callContained(module, "imported", 0, 0)
	if trap != "" || answer != binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(old[8:])*3+12345*5 || !bytes.Equal(old, containedBytes(64)) {
		t.Fatal("contained-load live backing mismatch", answer, trap)
	}
}

func TestContainedLoadShadowBarrier(t *testing.T) {
	host := new(containedHost)
	module := New(host)
	backing := containedBytes(64)
	*module.Xmemory().Slice() = backing[:16]
	host.callback = func() { *module.Xmemory().Slice() = backing[:3] }
	if _, trap := callContained(module, "shadow", 0, 0); trap != "memory" || len(host.events) != 1 || host.events[0].Kind != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("contained-load shadow purity mismatch: trap=%q events=%v", trap, host.events)
	}
}

func TestContainedLoadSelectionBarriers(t *testing.T) {
	for _, entry := range []struct {
		name   string
		length int
		flag   int32
	}{
		{"rebind", 12, 0}, {"conditional", 3, 0}, {"label", 3, 0},
	} {
		module := New(new(containedHost))
		*module.Xmemory().Slice() = containedBytes(64)[:entry.length]
		if _, trap := callContained(module, entry.name, 0, entry.flag); trap != "memory" {
			t.Fatal("contained-load selection barrier mismatch", entry, trap)
		}
	}
	module := New(new(containedHost))
	backing := containedBytes(64)
	*module.Xmemory().Slice() = backing
	containedBase = 1
	answer, trap := callContained(module, "global", 0, 0)
	if trap != "" || answer != binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(backing[9:])*3+binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(backing[1:])*5 {
		t.Fatal("contained-load global exclusion mismatch")
	}
	for _, base := range []int32{-1, -4, -12, 0x7fffffff} {
		if _, trap := callContained(module, "covered", base, 0); trap != "memory" {
			t.Fatal("contained-load widened address mismatch", base, trap)
		}
	}
	host := new(containedHost)
	module = New(host)
	*module.Xmemory().Slice() = backing[:7]
	if _, trap := callContained(module, "imported", 0, 0); trap != "memory" || len(host.events) != 0 || module.Xprefix() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("contained-load first trap/import prefix mismatch")
	}
}

func TestContainedLoadGrowthStorage(t *testing.T) {
	for _, spare := range []bool{false, true} {
		module := New(new(containedHost))
		capacity := 65536
		if spare {
			capacity *= 3
		}
		backing := make([]byte, 65536, capacity)
		copy(backing, containedBytes(65536))
		*module.Xmemory().Slice() = backing
		answer, trap := callContained(module, "grown", 0, 0)
		memory := *module.Xmemory().Slice()
		if trap != "" || answer != binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(backing[8:])*3+binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(backing)*5 || len(memory) != 131072 || (&memory[0] == &backing[0]) != spare || !bytes.Equal(memory[65536:], make([]byte, 65536)) {
			t.Fatal("contained-load growth storage mismatch", spare, answer, trap)
		}
	}
}

func TestContainedLoadDistinctBases(t *testing.T) {
	module := New(new(containedHost))
	backing := containedBytes(128)
	*module.Xmemory().Slice() = backing[:16]
	if _, trap := callContained(module, "two_bases", 0, 64); trap != "memory" || module.Xprefix() != 1 || !bytes.Equal(backing, containedBytes(128)) {
		t.Fatal("contained-load grouped parameter fact mismatch", trap)
	}
	answer, trap := callContained(module, "two_bases", 4, 0)
	if trap != "" || answer != binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(backing[12:])*3+binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(backing)*5 {
		t.Fatal("contained-load distinct base weighted mismatch", answer, trap)
	}
}
